findings.description: Single concurrency group and cancel-in-progress:false may queue successive release verification runs; false publication certification guarded by expected source SHA; no active failure reproduced.

Release-source script receives NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN, so branch/source trust and minimal provider token scope matter. Readback script examined and makes GET calls; no secret exposure or exploit demonstrated.
Public GET checks cannot substitute for signed-in Auth, mobile/offline, provider deployment integrity or full acceptance; sequential provider verification is separate.
